# FSx for ONTAP S3 Access Points Client Access Patterns

> A Spoke under the Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP Adoption Playbook. It holds how client tools
> (AWS CLI, s5cmd, rclone, Mountpoint for Amazon S3, and commercial transfer products) behave against
> S3 Access Points attached to FSx for ONTAP volumes: use cases, an integration map, a compatibility
> matrix, checklists, and one dated real-environment record. It does not copy specifications or limits.

## How to read this repository

Every cell of the compatibility matrix carries a confirmation level: `M` (measured, with a link to the
record), `D` (documented, with a URL and date), `C` (candidate, unconfirmed, no numbers). Use cases and
integrations carry an evidence class: public case, official expectation, or estimate. Do not state an
estimate or an official expectation as "works". Numbers are meaningful only with the environment stated
next to them (see the record).

Specifications and limits of S3 Access Points are in the Playbook, linked at a pinned commit
(docs/reference-pins.md). A question of the form "what is the limit on X" is answered there.

## Entry points

- [README (Japanese)](README.md) and [README (English)](README.en.md)
- [Use cases](docs/use-cases.en.md): on-premises ONTAP S3, new and existing FSx for ONTAP users (Japanese: docs/use-cases.md)
- [Integration map](docs/integrations-map.en.md): AWS services and products, use cases, and which client tool is involved
- [Compatibility matrix](docs/compatibility-matrix.en.md): per tool and operation, with confirmation level
- [How to choose](docs/how-to-choose.en.md) and [Mountpoint and S3 Access Points](docs/mountpoint-vs-s3-access-points.en.md)
- [Server-side copy and client tools](docs/server-side-copy.en.md)
- [2026-11-24 real-environment record](benchmarks/records/2026-11-24-client-tools-stage3.en.md)
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): conventions and verification steps for coding agents
